name: Rick Stein

source.title: Rick Stein restaurant menus with calories (13 PDFs on rickstein.com, created 21 April to 4 October 2026; read 2026-10-07)

note: Calories only, copied from each restaurant's own menu PDF: The Seafood Restaurant, St Petroc's Bistro and Rick Stein's Café (Padstow) and The Cornish Arms. Menus are samples and change often. Sandbanks, Barnes, Winchester, Fistral and Stein's Fish & Chips print no calories. The same dish can differ between restaurants.
